notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Dromar's Attendant.
description:
Cast Flourishing Fox either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Dromar's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Flourishing Fox by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
If you cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.
